description: This file is a Markdown document describing the HDMIOutput HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) interface, including design, capabilities, states, protocols, event handling, and usage scenarios for managing HDMI output ports in a platform. It contains detailed specifications, diagrams, and feature profiles related to HDMI output management.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Describes supported video formats, pixel formats, color spaces, HDCP versions, HDR modes, and other capabilities of HDMI outputs as defined in the HAL.

classes.name: HDCPStatus
classes.description: Enum representing HDCP authentication states, such as AUTHENTICATED, UNAUTHENTICATED, FAILURE, and UNKNOWN.

classes.name: HDROutputMode
classes.description: Enumeration of HDR output modes like AUTO, HDR10, HLG, DOLBY_VISION.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the capabilities of an HDMI output port, including supported modes, resolutions, and features.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the HDMI output port and begins signal detection and configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops HDMI output signal and deinitializes resources.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the HDMI port for signal transmission and detection.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the HDMI port and releases resources.

methods.name: getHDCPCurrentVersion
methods.description: Returns the current HDCP protocol version in use.

methods.name: getHDCPReceiverVersion
methods.description: Returns the HDCP version supported by the sink device.
